source: FRED series IRLTLT01AUQ156N (RBA-sourced, 10-year Australian Government bond yield), quarterly through Q4 2025. The 2026 point is a single secondary-source reading (Trading Economics, 19 Aug 2026) pending a full quarterly series for 2026 and should be treated as approximate.
note: This series is used as a reference rate for the cap rate risk premium (WACR minus the 10-year bond yield), a standard metric property investors use to judge whether cap rates are pricing property cheap or expensive relative to risk-free government debt.
